method: Two independently deformed authentic cloth panels, fixed rod/rings, local tieback lift and traveling hem deformation. Premultiplied alpha interpolation. No generic whole-image transform.

actions.idle: Small phase-offset hem sway; attachments fixed.
actions.attack: Panels gather inward in anticipation, tiebacks lift, panels part broadly and recover.
actions.hurt: Inward flinch, briefly compressed folds and an asymmetric hem flutter, then recover.
actions.defeat: Both panels bow and sag, then independently dissolve from the empty curtain rod; hold the remaining rod/rings.

quality_gate: Pending per-frame technical and visual sequence review; no browser attempt.
